sentences.span: Demand is clearly not the problem today... AI sells just fine; what matters now is what the money to build it costs
sentences.why: GS Basics (Privorotsky) directly frames the debate as having moved from demand to the cost/discounting of capital; the article's framing of a fragile bounce ('Bounce Or Bottom?', 'nothing approaching a full-scale return to risk-on') supports the fragility claim.

sentences.span: Demand is clearly not the problem today... The debate is how much we should discount those future cash flows given the uncertainty around supply, competition and financing
sentences.why: Verbatim quote attributed to 'the head of Goldman's EMEA delta-one desk' (Privorotsky, Goldman Sachs International, London); the cost-of-capital/no-obvious-solve line is his Oct 26 note in the same file set.

sentences.span: Goldman's chief credit strategist Amanda Lynam... puts off-balance sheet leases and purchase commitments across five leading hyperscalers at $2.8 trillion, an eightfold increase since 2023
sentences.why: Figure, attribution, and multiple ('eight times') all match exactly.

sentences.span: Per Goldman's credit sales strats, USD CCC spreads closed at 1,118bp... at the 100th percentile of the past three years
sentences.why: CCC is the riskiest junk tier; 100th percentile of the 3-year lookback is a fair restatement of 'highest in three years'.

sentences.span: GS still expects a 25bp hike to 4-4.25% on Dec 9... Rates: Strongest view is that central banks will hike less than priced
sentences.why: Both the specific Fed call and the 'strongest view' framing are verbatim in Goldman's Global Views summary.

sentences.span: We've stabilized in front end rates, objectively good for risk
sentences.why: Direct Privorotsky quote; front-end rates = short-dated rates.

sentences.span: The hyperscalers' perceived existential need for capital to build out compute capacity has led them to increasingly reach for equity financing in addition to debt issuance, especially as the latter starts to become more expensive
sentences.why: Near-verbatim match of the causal claim.

sentences.span: But in the aggregate for S&P 500 firms, FCF is set to fall given the enormous size of capex. That may interfere with buyback plans, in which case the headwind from positive equity supply would strengthen
sentences.why: Matches the FCF, capex and buyback-crimping claim exactly; citation markers [c638, c639] are not evidence per instructions.
